purpose: Teach: 捕まっ/のぼる/ウリ/難点/馬車/発熱/今ひとつ/苦い

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お外で、虫、捕まったんだよ、ぼく、可愛い、カマキリ、見つけたんだ、本当に、本当に!
lines.en: Mom! Outside — I caught a bug! I found the cutest mantis, Mom, really, really!
lines.style: Breathless excitement, words tumbling over each other. Quick attack on the opening. High energy throughout. Pitch bright and eager. Barely pausing between thoughts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さんが、階段をのぼる時、ちょっと、腰、痛そうだったわよ、翔くん、優しく、して、あげてね。
lines.en: Yes, sweetie. When Dad was climbing the stairs just now, his back looked a little sore. Be gentle with him, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft attack. Speaking to Sho with quiet care — not lecturing, just guiding. Warm and present. Slight concern underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの畑で、夏の、ウリ、たくさん、できたんだよ、ママ、お土産に、持って帰ろうね、絶対!
lines.en: And Grandpa's garden — there are so many melons ready this summer, Mom! Let's definitely bring some home with us, okay?
lines.style: Animated and proud. Eager to share his discovery. Quick pace, bright tone. The joy of having something to bring back. Conviction on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お引越し、難点が、いくつか、あるのよね、翔くん、転校するの、ママも、ちょっと、心配なのよ、本当に。
lines.en: Moving does have its challenges, you know. And I'm a little worried about you transferring schools, Sho. I really am.
lines.style: Reflective, honest. Slight heaviness in the opening. Speaking as much to herself as to him. Warm but carrying a real concern. Measured pace. Not burdening him, but not hiding it either.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 絵本の中の、馬車、本当に、素敵だよね、ママ、王子様、出てくる場面、ぼく、好きなんだ、本当に、本当に。
lines.en: The carriage in that picture book is so lovely, isn't it, Mom? I really love the scene where the prince appears. I really do.
lines.style: Reverent, slightly dreamy tone. Soft attack. Gentle wonder in his voice. Pace slows on the lovely parts. The repeated emphasis is genuine awe, not impatience.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨日、ぼく、ちょっと、発熱したのよ、ママ、心配したわよ、薬、飲んで、元気になってくれて、嬉しい、本当に。
lines.en: Yesterday you had that little fever, and I was so worried. I'm really glad you took your medicine and got better.
lines.style: Tender relief. Warm, genuine emotion. The worry and the gladness both present. Not overstated. Soft throughout. The kind of thing a mother says when fear has passed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 昨日の宿題、今ひとつ、わかんなかったよ、ママ、手伝ってくれる?明日、提出だから、お願い、本当に。
lines.en: I didn't quite understand my homework from yesterday, Mom. Can you help me? It's due tomorrow, so please?
lines.style: Earnest and a little uncertain. Polite ask — not demanding. The vulnerability of not understanding. Soft urgency at the end. Small voice seeking help.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: コーヒー、お父さん、苦いの、好きみたいよね、翔くんは、まだ、飲めないわよね、大人になってから、ね、楽しみね。
lines.en: Dad seems to like his coffee bitter, doesn't he? You can't drink it yet, Sho — but someday when you're grown up. That'll be fun to look forward to.
lines.style: Warm and close. Gentle observation. The tone of sharing a small secret about grown-up things. Playful forward-looking. Soft and familiar throughout.
